reasoning: On the season so far the Celtics are the stronger team; with home court the Celtics start about 6 points better, in a game of about 216 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Mavericks.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Mavericks (revenge, confidence).
Bottom line: the Celtics win 60 times in 100, by about 3; most games like this end between 190 and 238 total points.
